entities.summary: Pavel Durov (b. 1984-10-10, Saint Petersburg) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Saint Petersburg and United Arab Emirates. Known in the fields of united arab emirates, merchants & economists, asia.
